title: openOODA
tagline: Sovereign Systems Language for the AI Era
content:
## What it is

The openOODA polyrepo. Nine independent repositories that together form a sovereign, capability-secure systems language for the AI era. One `.oo` source compiles to four native targets. Every effect requires an explicit capability token. The standard library has zero ambient authority. Each repo owns its own surface, version, and release; the goal is to make them as independent of each other as possible while remaining functionally aligned.

The repositories cooperate through a single `ooda` binary and a content-addressed package registry. The compiler is the substrate; the standard library, package manager, CLI driver, language server, MCP server, and runtime are siblings, not dependencies.

## Surface

The nine polyrepo repos (as of 2026-09-03):

| Repo | Role | Status |
|------|------|--------|
| `openOODA/` | Governance: rules, north star, RFCs, polyrepo topology | v1.0.7 |
| `ooda/` | Legacy monorepo (will be killed when oodac/oodar fully replace it) | deprecated |
| `std/` | Standard library: 8 functional domains, 173 modules | v1.0.3 |
| `opm/` | Package manager: CAS-by-sha, capability-tagged | v0.8.x |
| `cli/` | The `ooda` binary driver, 13 subcommands | v0.2.1 |
| `lsp/` | Language server: 16 methods, 5 editor integrations | v0.6.2 |
| `mcp/` | MCP server: 23 tools, 5 tiers | v0.6.x |
| `oodar/` | Gen 1 C host substrate: 30 capability tokens, Landlock, arena, PQC, 6-subdir layout (core/sec/fs/net/hw/app) | v2.0.0 |
| `oodac/` | Compiler (extracted from `ooda/`; gemini v0.1.x reorg + cap-ABI alignment) | v0.1.x |
